title: Briefe und Akten zur Kirchenpolitik Friedrichs des Weisen und Johanns des Beständigen 1513 bis 1532
author: Frederick the Wise and John the Steadfast, Electors of Saxony, and correspondents
institution: Sächsische Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Leipzig (Manfred Rudersdorf, Armin Kohnle and team)
notes: Academy edition of the church-policy correspondence and records of the two electors. The online database lists 3,385 documents; for 1,760 of them (dated 1493 to December 1522) editing is marked complete. Of these, 330 show an edited source text beside the German summary, about 125,000 words; the others currently show a summary and metadata only, and the rest of the database is metadata. The printed volumes (three so far, the latest in December 2025) are not online here. Counts are ours, taken from the document pages, so they will grow as texts are added. Twelve further documents appear with full transcriptions and images under 'Kabinettstücke'. News on the site is dated October 2026.
